description: This Java source file defines the CalculatorUI class, which implements a graphical user interface for a calculator application using SWT. It manages UI components such as display, number buttons, and operation buttons, and interacts with the Calculator logic.

classes.name: CalculatorUI
classes.description: A class providing a SWT-based user interface for a calculator, implementing TextProvider and SelectionListener interfaces.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes the SWT display and opens the calculator UI window.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the calculator UI shell.

methods.name: CalculatorUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Calculator logic component.

methods.name: setupGUI
methods.description: Sets up the main GUI layout, including display, number buttons, and command buttons.

methods.name: setupDisplay
methods.description: Creates and initializes the display text widget.

methods.name: setupNumberButtons
methods.description: Creates number buttons (0-9 and decimal point).

methods.name: addNumberButton
methods.description: Adds a number button to the UI and attaches selection listener.

methods.name: setupCommandButtons
methods.description: Creates operation buttons based on the Operations instance.

methods.name: addCommandButton
methods.description: Adds an operation button and attaches selection listener.

methods.name: widgetDefaultSelected
methods.description: Empty implementation for default widget selection event.

methods.name: widgetSelected
methods.description: Handles button click events, passing the button text to the calculator logic.

methods.name: setDisplayText
methods.description: Updates the display text widget with the provided string.

methods.name: getDisplayText
methods.description: Returns the current text from the display widget.
